Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — on-prem/VPC demo

Hi Vivek,

I self-signed up for the pilot form and indicated interest in an on-prem/VPC demo for MedSecure. We're in the process of lining up IT and Security but I wanted to flag that our deploy windows are pretty constrained the week of Apr 19 — only afternoons PT work for all stakeholders, plus we need a 60–90 minute block that includes a short SOC2/networking evidence Q&A.

I've attached our internal availability grid to make scheduling easier. Can you propose a couple of matrix-aligned slots that include both an engineering walkthrough and the compliance Q&A?

Thanks,
Jane

Hi Jane — welcome and thanks for the grid. Appreciate the constraints callout.

Quick proposal:
- Option A: Tue Apr 20, 2027 — 1:00pm–2:30pm PT (90m) — Ops + Security Q&A during last 25m
- Option B: Wed Apr 21, 2027 — 2:30pm–3:30pm PT (60m) — if you prefer a shorter, focused walkthrough + separate follow-up for evidence

Olga is looping in to confirm technical attendee list and whether we should bring our network engineer for the SOC2/network walk. Soojin is on hand to collect required evidence (certs, audit log format) and map it to your compliance ask.

If those work, I can send calendar invites and a short prep doc (1 page) so stakeholders know what to expect. If neither fit, tell me two afternoon slots that you prefer and we'll lock one down.

Best,
Vivek

Thanks Vivek — both look promising. A couple of constraints:
- Our Security lead (Matthew C.) prefers Apr 20 but is out 1:30–2:00pm PT.
- The SOC2 question set needs a copy of the last quarter's network diagram and a redacted SOC2 bridge letter ahead of the call.

Attached is an updated availability grid (we removed a conflicting meeting) and a short compliance priority doc. Prefer Option A but can do Apr 21 if necessary.

Jane

Hi all — thanks for the attachments, Jane.

Operational plan for the slot:
- 0–10m: intros and success criteria (Vivek to lead)
- 10–55m: technical walkthrough — architecture, network requirements, KMS/HSM options, and a short demo of private control plane flows
- 55–80m: compliance & evidence Q&A — Soojin will field SOC2/artifact questions, I can share example network diagrams/redaction guidance
- Optional 80–90m: follow-ups and next steps (procurement/next pilot steps)

Soojin — can you prep the evidence checklist we usually share for regulated pilots and a short redaction example? If we get the SOC2 bridge letter earlier, we can pre-annotate the network diagram to save time on the call.

Jane — if Apr 20 is still preferred, I'll tentatively hold 1:00–2:30pm PT while we get confirmations. I will not send the final invite until Vivek confirms stakeholders.

Thanks,
Olga
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

I've sent the calendar invite (link: https://calendar.redwood.com/invite/rdw-8341) and attached the one-pager prep doc + pilot agenda. Soojin will follow up separately with the evidence checklist and a secure upload link; please upload the SOC2 bridge letter and network diagram at least 24 hours before the session.

- Confirm final attendee list for the 90m block (esp. Matthew for the compliance segment)
- Upload SOC2 bridge letter + redacted network diagram by EOD Apr 19

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll adapt. Looking forward to it.
